crossRefs.note: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were…
God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or…
It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will…
But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.
translations.bsb: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his house, from beginning to end.
translations.kjv: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.
translations.asv: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even unto the end.
